reference.title: Troubleshoot the Self Node Remediation Operator
reference.shortdesc: Review these solutions for common issues that you might encounter when using the Self Node Remediation Operator.

dlentry.dd: You want to troubleshoot issues with the Self Node Remediation Operator.
The Self Node Remediation Operator is installed but the daemon set is not available.
Check the Operator logs for errors or warnings.
An unhealthy node was not remediated.

dd.p: Verify that the SelfNodeRemediation CR was created by running the following command:

If the MachineHealthCheck controller did not create the SelfNodeRemediation CR when the node turned unhealthy, check the logs of the MachineHealthCheck controller. Additionally, ensure that the MachineHealthCheck CR includes the required specification to use the remediation template.
If the SelfNodeRemediation CR was created, ensure that its name matches the unhealthy node or the machine object.

section.title: Resources remain after uninstalling the Operator

dlentry.dd: The Self Node Remediation Operator resources, such as the daemon set, configuration CR, and the remediation template CR, exist even after after uninstalling the Operator.
